summary: STORE-009 DESIGN JOURNEY REBUILD verified. JourneyOperatingPage renders correctly at /studio/journey/:jid with all 11 required data-testids. Phase rail (7 steps), roadmap, center column (checklist + assets), client snapshot all present. Interaction: clicking rail/roadmap switches center column without reload. Legacy ?_legacy=1 correctly renders ProjectDetailPage. Backend /api/journeys/{jid}/overview shape intact (journey/account/brief/milestones_flat/milestones_by_track/artifact_counts/timeline_recent). NULL budget/timeline render 'Not set' without crash. CURATE phase merges moodboards + material boards (2 cards rendered).

issues: Timeline events render raw backend event_type strings like 'milestone_started' and 'journey_started'. While not editorial copy per se, the word 'milestone' is technically visible in the rendered text — STORE-009 forbids the word 'Milestone' in the operating UI. Recommend humanizing event_type values (e.g., 'milestone_started' → 'Step started', 'journey_started' → 'Journey started') so operational language stays consistent.

action_items: (Optional polish) Humanize timeline event_type labels in jop-client-snapshot Recent Activity list to remove the literal word 'milestone'/'journey_started' from the rendered text. Map technical events to operational copy in JourneyOperatingPage.jsx around line 415.
critical_code_review_comments: JourneyOperatingPage.jsx is 437 lines — within the 700-line guideline. Well-structured: phase mapping (27-55), data fetching (118-145), useMemo derivations (148-199), render (210+). DRY respected.

Data fetching pattern: 5 parallel GETs (projects, moodboards, material-boards, specifications, project-stories). Each .catch(()=>null) swallows errors silently — acceptable for non-critical accessory data but no toast/log surface for ops debugging. Consider lightweight console.warn on failures.
relatedAssets useMemo (177-189) hard-codes per-phase asset mapping — clean and predictable. DISCOVER/INSPIRE return [] (intentional, brief mandates 'No assets are linked to this phase yet').
Backend overview endpoint returns an extra additive field 'open_health_signals' not listed in the brief's expected shape — additive only, no regression to existing consumers.

Pre-existing React 'setState during render' warning visible in console (mentioned in brief as ProjectDetailPage warnings) — fires even on the new page due to shared sidebar/topbar components. Not blocking but worth a future cleanup sprint.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing journey bb8ee381-58f8-4b76-9255-b9fd2020bc0f (project 'Conversazione di stefano', client 'stefano') as supplied in the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: STORE-009 Daily Operating Workspace passes all 11 acceptance criteria. Verified evidence: (a) backend overview shape unchanged, project_id resolves to 930b31dc-1e1f-46c7-97d8-515ead998a52; (b) frontend renders journey-operating with all required testids and 7 rail steps DISCOVER→CELEBRATE; (c) clicking jop-rail-celebrate switches center title to 'Celebrate' and clicking 3rd roadmap button switches to 'Curate' with 2 asset cards (1 moodboard + 1 material board) appearing; (d) ?_legacy=1 hides jop-phase-rail and renders the legacy ProjectDetailPage with editorial tabs (Overview, Ispirazioni, Moodboard, Materiali, Proposte, Conversazioni, Timeline); (e) NULL budget/timeline render 'Not set' without crash. Only minor cosmetic finding: timeline_recent event_type strings are rendered raw ('milestone_started') — recommend humanization, not blocking.
rca_of_issues: No bugs found. Only one cosmetic suggestion: humanize raw backend event_type strings in Recent Activity to keep operational language pure.
